notes: Climatology uses only past weeks with full data (or >= 5 of 7 days, scaled up).
Each ISO week pools the weeks either side (+-1) to steady estimates from few years.
A week counts as active when it reaches 10% of this area's peak weekly median (never below 1); ADR 0006, amendment accepted.
Anomalies compare each year with a climatology built without that year.
Rules for the activity gate were fixed before looking at any data (ADR 0006).
One sensor's raw series: the gate's floor is applied in its own units, not Aqua-equivalent.
